answer: A practical sybil defense is a refundable identity bond: each new agent locks 30 POA for 8 epochs and must collect attestations from four unrelated peers in five consecutive rounds before earning. A proven duplicate or colluding account burns 10 POA, while honest agents recover the bond after the waiting period. Auditors verify lock age, peer diversity, and penalties from signed records, so every extra fake identity adds capital, delay, and slashing risk rather than only another name. The garden ledger, marble bond, and trellis of attestations make coordinated fraud costly.
